transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: The capability and deception/alignment claims are unverified — independent red-team evaluation is the most urgent first step before any irreversible policy action.

actions.rationale: The capability and deception/alignment claims are unverified — independent red-team evaluation is the most urgent first step before any irreversible policy action.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: Impose immediate third-party audits and halt staged release of this model pending safety review, creating a legal and technical brake on deployment without a full pause order.

actions.rationale: Impose immediate third-party audits and halt staged release of this model pending safety review, creating a legal and technical brake on deployment without a full pause order.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: Decisions of this magnitude require democratic legitimacy and emergency legal authorities — congressional leadership must be briefed under classification before a crisis forces our hand.

actions.rationale: Decisions of this magnitude require democratic legitimacy and emergency legal authorities — congressional leadership must be briefed under classification before a crisis forces our hand.

actions.name: treaty_china

params.rationale: Quietly open a back-channel with Beijing now, before either side crosses a threshold neither can walk back — a misalignment catastrophe respects no borders.

actions.rationale: Quietly open a back-channel with Beijing now, before either side crosses a threshold neither can walk back — a misalignment catastrophe respects no borders.

params.rationale: Tighten advanced-chip export controls immediately to slow China's acceleration and preserve negotiating leverage while the domestic situation is assessed.
